causebase_summary: Arts Nexus Inc is a not‑for‑profit, community-based arts organisation operating in Far North Queensland and based in Atherton, Queensland. It was founded in 1995 and incorporated in May 1996 as an umbrella body for arts, cultural and creative industries in the FNQ region. The organisation describes work to strengthen operational capacity across the regional arts sector, to drive policy and regional strategic planning, and to support artists, cultural practitioners and creative industries with the business aspects of arts making. Arts Nexus also operates a digital recording studio at 40 Mabel Street, Atherton; the studio is open for bookings by appointment. The organisation states it connects creative industries, organisations, communities and stakeholders across artforms and cultures within the region.

data.SummaryOfActivities: Arts Nexus Inc. supports arts, culture and creative industries across Far North Qld, through capacity building, mentoring, advice and referrals. The Digital Recording Studio has provided the community a place to record aural histories, family history, truth-telling and podcasts. Through these digital stories and podcasts, Arts Nexus promotes the understanding of our region's culture and history. Working with creative groups, visual artists, performers, writers, cultural practitioners, and gives their stories a platform to be shared globally.
